about: fid29 judge config (frozen after fid29-base; docs/game3d/fid29/COMMON.md gate C5). judge29.py reads it.

questions.game: Which screenshot looks more like a top-tier realistic mobile game? Judge rendering quality only.
questions.defect: Which shows more visible flaws (shimmer, stair-steps, smears, seams, broken geometry, white-out)?
questions.face_sun: Which face looks lit by the sun?

win_rule: a side wins a pair only when both orders name it; otherwise tie (both say tie) or split

sealed_heldout.rule: never rendered by any lane during development; rendered and judged once on the lane's final commit

defect_rule: new judged more flawed in at most 10% of pairs
